222.canonical: Use prompt files (*.prompt.md, stored at .github/prompts/) for reusable, task-specific chat interactions run repeatedly with different inputs, kept distinct from codebase-wide custom instructions and invoked manually.

232.canonical: Build a validation feedback loop into quality-critical or refinement workflows: define quality criteria, run validation, fix the concrete failures, and repeat until the gate passes before finalizing.

240.canonical: Match instruction strictness to task fragility: use heuristic prose for open-ended judgment where multiple approaches are valid, parameterized patterns for a preferred approach that tolerates variation, and exact/prescriptive commands that forbid deviation for fragile operations or fixed sequences.

253.canonical: Match scaffolding to model capability and re-evaluate it whenever a more capable model ships — a stronger model needs less scaffolding, so strip pieces that are no longer load-bearing and add pieces that unlock newly-possible capability — while keeping the design grounded in what has been tested for the task.
